build_initial_hypothesis_nodes: build initial hypothesis nodes for baseline, headspace cache, and MTP experiments from config and state
plan_followup_experiments: plan follow-up experiments by querying the coding agent with current state, history, and findings
get_plan_from_agent: get the next experiment plan from the coding agent using knowledge, pipeline code, and iteration context
compute_thread_cap_for_experiment: compute the maximum thread cap per rank based on GPU count and historical experiment results
validate_thread_budget_for_experiments: validate a list of experiment specs against a thread budget cap and log rejected experiments
